description: IMOS - Combined Biogeochemical parameters (reference stations) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. This dataset includes the biogeochemical (BGC) parameters collected and analysed from the National Reference Stations (NRS) excluding the biological compositional data which can be accessed through other products. Nine Sites are included in the IMOS NRS field sampling stations. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Biosphere | Aquatic Habitat | Coastal Habitat, Biosphere | Aquatic Habitat | Pelagic Habitat, Coastal Cities / Towns (Australia) | Darwin, NT, Coastal Cities / Towns (Australia) | Esperance, WA, Countries | Australia. It offers 25 resource(s) in html, pdf, png, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
